bio: I'm a software engineer focused on AI engineering, developer tooling and open-source contributions. I work across Python, React, TypeScript and agentic systems; my published work spans contributions to upstream OSS tools and frameworks and a handful of personal initiatives, such as VS Code extensions. Outside of code I'm usually tinkering with terminals or sketching ideas that may or may not ship. I'm also a big fan of Monokai, as you can see :)
